title: Something Changed
action: KAIRO's slight smile fades. He leans back into the chair and looks into the distance, remembering.
lighting: one side of the face lit, the other eye in shadow
audio: clock tick stops, low sub-bass swell begins
dialogue_fa: منم یه زمانی مثل همه فکر می‌کردم... تا اینکه یه اتفاقی افتاد. اتفاقی که همه‌چیز رو عوض کرد.
gloss_en: I used to think like everyone else... until something happened. Something that changed everything.
transition: push continues into the eyes, setting up the match cut in S05
